QuestInfo.name: [NLC] Otherworldly Assistance
QuestInfo.0: Corine says she'd like to introduce you to her companion, Elpam.
QuestInfo.1: Meet Elpam, who has been traveling with Corine.
QuestInfo.2: To your surprise, Elpam was a historian who happened to be visiting from Versal.

npc.0: Elpam, my traveling companion, has something to ask of you too. Could you meet with him and hear him out?
